## Summary

**UNPACK1632** (Unpack 16 bit color to 32 bit color): Unpack 16 Bit RGB565 data into 32 Bit ARGB.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `<vea> convert → d:d2` |
| Syntax | `UNPACK1632 <vea>,d:d2` |
| Short | Unpack 16 Bit RGB565 data into 32 Bit ARGB. |
| Description | Convert gfx mode. Expand 4 16 bit color into 2 x 2 32 bit color. |
| Constraints | The destination register index pair are restricted to a multiple of two (i.e. D0:D1,D2:D3 etc.) |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | `0` |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | `0000` |
| 2 | 11–9 | d |
| 2 | 8–0 | `000011110` |

### Example

```asm
    unpack1632    d0,d2:d3
```

```text
vea d0: F8 00 07 E0 F8 1F 00 1F
Result:
d d2:d3: 00 FF 00 00 00 00 FF 00
         00 FF 00 FF 00 00 00 FF
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no UNPACK1632. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- DO use a destination pair starting at an even register (D0:D1, D2:D3, ...).
